notes: V30.35 keeps the rigid RGB-only spherical panorama and adds global per-channel exposure compensation. Exact-frame Depth Anything maps are synchronized through RGB-verified spherical overlap masks using robust layer anchors and monotone nonlinear piecewise depth transfers. Fusion is uncertainty-weighted with two depth hypotheses per atlas pixel; Hann feathering is applied only inside true RGB overlap, preserving coverage and avoiding arithmetic averaging across incompatible surfaces. The global display range is shared by the whole depth atlas. 3-D reconstruction remains unchanged.
